hypothesis: Request270 shows the frozen one-state continuation target generalizes on top-5% candidates. Recurrently applying that one-step value should outperform static exits without using future-best stopping labels.
policy: At each position state HOLD iff predicted one-step continuation advantage > 0 and P(one-step advantage > 0) >= 0.50. Reconsider at the next state. Terminal state always exits.
comparators: fifth observed post-entry exit with terminal fallback
forbidden: changing candidate admission or entry timing
next_if_pass: Add learned causal entry timing on top of candidate admission plus one-step HOLD/EXIT.
next_if_fail: Use fitted policy iteration so HOLD targets reflect the value of the frozen downstream policy rather than a single fixed step.
